# Punt FT%: Player Targets

**Summary.** Punt FT% works in our league only if you pair bad free throw shooters with players who bring assists, threes and steals. If you stack only poor shooters, you also give up points, threes and assists. Anchor around Giannis or Barnes plus a frontcourt piece like Mobley, then buy Daniels, Ausar Thompson, Siakam and Gobert at fair prices. None of the punt FT% targets in this pool is a source of threes, so you must buy threes from other players.

## Punt one category, not four

Free throws are linked to points, threes and assists. A roster of only bad free throw shooters ends up punting four categories, not one. In a 9-cat H2H matchup that loses most weeks. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=568))

The fix is guard stats bought early. If you take a poor shooter like Giannis, you still need assists or threes in the early rounds. Our draft is an auction, so think of it this way: of your next three big buys after the anchor, two should be guards or players who bring assists, threes or steals. Do not chase more low free throw players with that money. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=756), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=561), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=524))

Every player line below notes the guard stats he brings. Use that note to check your build. After each purchase, count how many of AST, 3PTM, ST and PTS your roster still covers. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=568), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323))

## Where the experts disagree

Experts split on whether Giannis forces the punt. One side says that if you draft a bad free throw shooter like Giannis, you should punt FT% and build around it. The other side says taking Giannis in round one does not mean you must punt free throws or target other bad shooters, and that every player is still a target. Both sides agree on one thing: do not fill the team with bad free throw players. ([09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=561), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=856), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=524))

There is a second, smaller split on how to treat free throw history. One note warns against punting FT% because of one bad season, since FT% swings both ways. Another says to draft a poor shooter expecting bad free throws, so any improvement is a bonus. For us, that means you should not let one bad FT season push a player into the punt pool. Mobley's FT% is the case to watch. ([08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1274), [08-11](https://youtu.be/OdDkXFhoKsc?t=714), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md))

## Price discipline at the auction

Do not bid up players just because they rise in punt FT% rankings. Other managers can see those rankings too. Stop at fair value and let the rest go. Several of these players went for much more in our league last season than experts now think they are worth, including Mobley, Kessler and Banchero. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=2379), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Paolo Banchero](../profiles/players/paolo-banchero.md))

A workable spend: about 60 USD on Giannis and about 35 to 40 USD on Barnes, leaving roughly 100 USD for ten spots. Mobley at 25 to 30 USD and Daniels at up to 20 USD add frontcourt and steals. Fill the rest with Gobert at 8 to 12 USD, Zion at about 6 USD and Claxton at 1 to 2 USD. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Scottie Barnes](../profiles/players/scottie-barnes.md), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md), [Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md), [Zion Williamson](../profiles/players/zion-williamson.md), [Nic Claxton](../profiles/players/nic-claxton.md))

Overall 9-cat rankings undersell these players for you. If a target's FT% falls and his rank drops, that barely matters in a punt FT% build. Judge him on the other eight categories. ([07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=2097))

## The gap in this pool: threes

No player in the punt FT% pool is flagged as a source of threes. Daniels, Zion and Claxton are listed as punt 3PM fits too. Ausar Thompson projects no threes. Daniels shot 18% from three last season. Kessler's threes from last season look unlikely to repeat. ([Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Zion Williamson](../profiles/players/zion-williamson.md), [Nic Claxton](../profiles/players/nic-claxton.md), [Ausar Thompson](../profiles/players/ausar-thompson.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md))

So you have to buy threes from players outside this list. Budget for at least two guards who bring 3PTM. Otherwise you slide into a punt FT% plus 3PTM build without meaning to. Assists are easier to find here: Giannis, Barnes, Sengun, Banchero, Castle and Daniels all bring them. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=756), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=561), [Scottie Barnes](../profiles/players/scottie-barnes.md), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Stephon Castle](../profiles/players/stephon-castle.md), [Paolo Banchero](../profiles/players/paolo-banchero.md))

## Early season and playoff checks

Check minutes and roles in the first weeks. Is Giannis getting 32 to 33 minutes and running point? Is Barnes keeping his usage next to Leonard? Does Ausar Thompson reach 28 minutes? Is Gobert getting more minutes? Is Castle losing assists to Dylan Harper? Daily lineups help here. Starting a poor free throw shooter early in games can also protect him from hack-a-player tactics, because there are no team fouls early on. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Scottie Barnes](../profiles/players/scottie-barnes.md), [Ausar Thompson](../profiles/players/ausar-thompson.md), [Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md), [Stephon Castle](../profiles/players/stephon-castle.md), [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=1790))

Weeks 19 to 21 are thin for several of these players. Miami plays a weak 4-3-3. Houston plays only 10 games. Indiana plays 3-4-3. Gobert has a two-game semifinal in week 20. Boston has three back-to-backs in our playoff weeks. Plan trades before the 2027-03-04 deadline with this in mind. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md), [Mitchell Robinson](../profiles/players/mitchell-robinson.md))
